names: UCSF Neurosurgery at San Francisco Mission Bay
Joan and Sanford I. Weill Neurosciences Building
summary: This record's geometry is the owner-identified footprint west of and adjacent to Third Street Garage on OCII plan Block 23A; that address and adjacency match the Joan and Sanford I. Weill Neurosciences Building at 1651 4th Street, a six-story, roughly 282,500-sq-ft neuroscience research and clinical building (design architect Mark Cavagnero Associates with SmithGroup as executive architect) that opened in October 2021. UCSF Health's own 'Neurosurgery Mission Bay - Fourth St.' clinic listing gives the same 1651 4th Street address.

milestones.text: UC Regents Committee on Grounds and Buildings approves $21,000,000 in preliminary-plans funding for the Mission Bay Neurosciences Research Building (Block 23A) -- a 270,000 gsf, six-story building on the Block 23A surface parking lot that became this building -- with full budget, financing and design/CEQA approval expected in March 2017 and construction targeted for fall 2017
Construction completed, per architecture trade press (Architectural Record)
Joan and Sanford I. Weill Neurosciences Building opens, welcoming patients for neurology, neurosurgery and psychiatric care alongside the Weill Institute for Neurosciences' research programs

open_questions: This record's own geometry file notes the owner directly identified the building here as UCSF Neurosurgery at Mission Bay (correcting an earlier mis-resolution to Genentech Hall) but flags that identification as not independently corroborated by a primary source in that pass. This research pass found strong, independent corroboration: a contractor project page names this same OCII Block 23A as the site of the Joan and Sanford I. Weill Neurosciences Building, and UCSF Health's own clinic-location page places its 'Neurosurgery Mission Bay - Fourth St.' service at 1651 4th Street, the Weill building's address, directly adjacent to Third Street Garage as this record's geometry describes. Not treated as fully closed: no single source explicitly ties the parcel-level footprint to the 1651 4th Street address by lot number.

Exact opening day is not confirmed: this record uses October 2021 (from UCSF's own news article, dated by its URL and by architecture-press coverage of the same announcement); one secondary aggregation suggested October 28, 2021 specifically, but that day was not independently verified against a primary page in this pass.

Construction cost is reported elsewhere (via a $185 million naming gift from the Weill Family Foundation, and a total project value cited by some outlets around $535 million) but was not independently verified against a primary UCSF or Regents document in this pass, so left out of costs.

2026-09-21 pass: the March 2016 Regents preliminary-plans item (270,000 gsf, six stories) predates the Weill naming gift and 'Weill Neurosciences Building' name; identification with this record rests on the Block 23A site match (confirmed elsewhere in this record's own sources), not a name match in the 2016 item itself.
